name: Brianna
headline: I didn't do it perfectly. I just kept showing up.
subhead: Over 150 lbs down, and the question I get every single day is how I stayed consistent. This is me answering it every week, next to people starting exactly where you are.

inside.title: My training week, written out
inside.text:
The same sessions I do, in the order I do them, with the sets and the reps.
There's an easier version of every week for when you're just starting, because I remember what week one felt like.

inside.title: What I eat, so Monday isn't a guess
inside.text:
My meals and the staples that are always in my kitchen, written out so you're not rebuilding your whole diet every Sunday night.
Nothing on there that I don't actually eat myself.

inside.title: Everything I learned about loose skin
inside.text:
It's the question I get more than any other, and it was my own biggest fear too.
What I did about it, what actually helped, and what I wish someone had told me at the start.

inside.title: The chat, and I'm in it
inside.text:
Post your wins, your bad days, and the questions you'd be embarrassed to ask anywhere else.
Someone always answers, and a lot of the time it's me.

inside.title: The week you fall off
inside.text:
It happens to everyone, and it's the week most people quit for good. It's the week I nearly did.
There's a place for exactly that, and I'm in it.

inside.title: Challenges we start together
inside.text:
Everyone begins on the same day, and the leaderboard counts both the pounds lost and the percent of your own bodyweight.
So someone starting at 300 and someone starting at 170 are both in it to win.

inside.title: People who are starting where you are
inside.text:
Not a feed full of people who already finished. People at the beginning of their own 150, posting what's working and what isn't.
It's a lot harder to quit in week two when they're all still going.

lockedLine: Whatever you join at is what you pay for as long as you stay. It goes up for the people who come later, not for you.
